_comment: Transit-to-natal rules for scripts/transit_to_natal.py. Values copied verbatim from luminous_gate_reconstruction.json (version 2.1.1-proposed-reconstruction) section aspects_orbs; no orbs invented. Parameters under 'documented_parameters' are NOT defined there and are conservative, labelled engine parameters pending user decision.

Moon (DAILY only).minor: n/a (SPEC '—': minor aspects not used for this class)

Uranus, Neptune, Pluto.minor: n/a (SPEC '—': minor aspects not used for this class)

transit_to_natal_orbs_deg.natal_target_bonus: +0.5 degree when natal target is Sun, Moon, ASC or MC (time known)
transit_to_natal_orbs_deg.angles: aspects to DSC/IC produced as mirror of ASC/MC and deduplicated

speed_source_order: central difference on six-month series wrap180(L[i+1]-L[i-1])/2
motion.f: f(t) = wrap180(lambda_T(t) - lambda_N - s*A); s in {+1,-1}, s=+1 only when A in {0,180}; choose side with smallest |f|

steps: compute f at all six-month samples
hit: f(t_i)*f(t_i+1) <= 0 and |f(t_i)-f(t_i+1)| < 30; linear interpolation; quadratic near stations (|speed| < 0.05 deg/day)
touch: local min |f| <= orb without sign change = NEAR_MISS (not a hit)
window: contiguous samples with |f| <= orb; entry/exit interpolated
series: all windows and hits of one signature in horizon = one TransitSeries
Moon: use weekly 6 h snapshots or daily position + speed; round to the hour
times stored UTC, displayed in user tz with label

stations.rule: sign change of daily motion in six-month series, quadratic vertex refine
stations.station_on_point: station longitude within 1.5 degree of conj/opp/square point of a natal point

ingresses_returns_cycles_lunations.sign_ingress: signIndex change; interpolate to 30-degree boundary; reingress flag; Sun..Pluto, Chiron, True_Node
ingresses_returns_cycles_lunations.house_ingress: time known only; root of wrap180(lambda_T - cusp_k)
ingresses_returns_cycles_lunations.returns: transiting body conjunct own natal position; ordinal from age/mean period labelled approximate
ingresses_returns_cycles_lunations.cycle_checkpoints: square/opposition to own natal position; phase = norm(lambda_T - lambda_N) (nodes: norm(lambda_N - lambda_T)); 8 phases of 45 degrees New..Balsamic
ingresses_returns_cycles_lunations.lunations: New = root wrap180(Moon-Sun); Full = root wrap180(Moon-Sun-180); on natal point within 3 (conj) or 2 (opp/sq) degrees
ingresses_returns_cycles_lunations.eclipse_candidate: syzygy with |Moon ecl_lat| < 1.6 (new) or < 1.1 (full); 'candidate' until eclipse table imported

body_classes._provenance: luminous_gate_reconstruction.json celestial_layers.body_classes (SPEC §4.2); Mean_Node excluded by default; South_Node derived from True_Node

sampling_adequacy_max_daily_step_deg.rule: a transiting series is computed from daily six-month samples only if the body's max |daily step| < 10 deg; faster points (Moon, Aether SunMoon/Elemental) are reported as sampling_insufficient (Moon is DAILY-only per the orb table)

recurring_activation_min_windows.rule: recurring activation = the same transit signature (body, aspect, side, natal point) re-enters orb in >= 2 separate windows inside the horizon (distinct from multi-pass inside one window)

convergence_min_simultaneous_windows.rule: candidate convergence = >= 3 distinct transiting bodies from the listed classes simultaneously inside orb of the SAME natal point (sample-level); candidate only because 'unique signal' is undefined

fixed_stars_in_transit_series.rule: fixed stars do not move appreciably over six months; natal fixed-star contacts are natal-level and not transit series
